Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every six months 
as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The set up 
transformer kv Rating 11.5/220KV, ∆/Y, ONAF
The first draft initiated by eng. Abd El-Gayd Abd 
El-Wahab, tested by eng. Gamal El-Sedik Abu El-Esaad, accepted by eng. Yousry 
Ahmed Abd El-Maksoud; general director, revised by 
EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Adel Abd 
El-Qader El-Nagar, 
approved by eng. Fathy Ragap head sector of Talkha PS
This document accepted by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, and quality control general 
director and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category.
Maintenance staff should be well 
 trained and qualified or directly supervised by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 breathing mask, safety glasses etc .
Transformer and the unit must be out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, shoes, ... etc .
Complete tool set, air blower.
Megger, multimeter
AC & DC Voltmeter, Clampmeter ( AC ammeter )
Tan delta device.
Work to be Carried Out
Step # | Item | Test Results
1 | Check that the transformer 
 de-energized | 
2 | Clean the 
 surface of the transformer | 
3 | Clean the I/P 
 and O/P Bushing of transformer | 
4 | Check the 
 connection for each coil of three phase | 
5 | Check the tank 
 level oil | 
6 | Check the pressure of the 
 nitrogen cylinder | 
7 | Clean the 
 cooling radiator | 
8 | Check all 
 protection devices | 
9 | Record oil 
 temperature | 
10 | Record max 
 winding temperature | 
11 | Check tightness 
 all bolted connection | 
12 | Measure and record insulation 
 resistance |
